inspiration.observed_pattern: Independent category lists are assigned stable ordinal positions and aligned with outer joins so rows from the preserved category remain visible when the other category is shorter.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one northern item and two southern items. ROW_NUMBER assigns slots and RIGHT JOIN preserves the unmatched second southern slot with NULL northern values; the schema, data, and labels are independently authored.

fixture_notes: One northern item matches the first southern slot; the second southern slot must remain visible with NULL northern columns.
determinism_notes: Fixed item IDs, names, slot ordering, and final ordering contain no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE regional_catalog_mini (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, region_code CHAR(1) NOT NULL, item_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH northern AS (SELECT item_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY item_name, item_id) AS slot FROM regional_catalog_mini WHERE region_code = 'N'), southern AS (SELECT item_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY item_name, item_id) AS slot FROM regional_catalog_mini WHERE region_code = 'S') SELECT n.slot AS north_slot, n.item_name AS north_item, s.slot AS south_slot, s.item_name AS south_item FROM northern AS n RIGHT JOIN southern AS s ON n.slot = s.slot ORDER BY s.slot
